name: Rusty Whitesided Caterpillar
desc: Rusty Whitesided Caterpillar (Orthosia revicta): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Orthosia revicta, known generally as the subdued Quaker or rusty whitesided caterpillar, is a species of cutworm or dart moth in the family Noctuidae. It is found in North America.
